before: Review items listed every property-change element, one item per paragraph for a paragraph-property change, and kept insertions or deletions apart across a tracked paragraph mark when their dates differed.
after: Each replica leaves out property changes that resolve to the same formatting, joins identical paragraph-property changes on consecutive paragraphs, and joins edits across a tracked paragraph mark whatever their dates. reason: Only the derived review queue changes. Shared nodes, text offsets, operations, and package serialization remain unchanged, and every replica derives the same queue from the shared tree.
